steps: Start mock API on 127.0.0.1:8793 with fresh stats and static server for the built app on 127.0.0.1:8098.
Open the app with Edge headless CDP at 320x800, 768x1024 and 1440x900 (DPR 1).
Navigate to the pending prompt-preview project and capture the pending card at each viewport.
Navigate to the checking prompt-preview project and capture the disabled CTA while copy remains enabled.
Click 复制提示词, read the clipboard through CDP, and capture 已复制 before the 2000ms reset.
Click the confirm CTA once, capture the confirmed/read-only card within the 3s hold, and record the single confirm_prompt request.
Navigate to the overlong prompt-preview project, scroll the card body, and capture the sticky CTA at each viewport.
Verify card typography, facts grid, CTA geometry, page overflow and request counts for every scenario.
